scientific_integrity: All-parameter homotopy classification is derived by a symbolic facet description and explicit elementary simplicial collapse sequence. Finite Python tests corroborate nine cases only. Scientific originality has residual unindexed-literature risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the full strong Morse matching complex of the one-dimensional complete bipartite graph \(K_{m,n}\), \(m,n\ge2\). It does not address the pure complex, arbitrary bipartite graphs, higher-dimensional input, or automorphism modules. The m=n=2 case was previously known.
title: Complete bipartite strong Morse complexes collapse to doubled graph spines
